name: My So-Called Life
description: The life of a 15 year-old high school student, whose angst-ridden journey through adolescence, friendship, parents, and life teaches her what it means to grow up.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Angela Chase begins new friendships at school.

videos.title: Dancing in the Dark
videos.overview: Jordan sells Angela a fake ID.

videos.title: Guns and Gossip
videos.overview: A rumor makes the rounds that Angela slept with Jordan.

videos.title: Father Figures
videos.overview: The printing shop owned by Patty's father is audited.

videos.title: The Zit
videos.overview: A list rating the sophomore girls makes the rounds.

videos.title: The Substitute
videos.overview: Liberty High deals with the issue of censorship when a substitute English teacher encourages students to write liberal poetry for the school paper.

videos.title: Why Jordan Can't Read
videos.overview: Angela makes a real connection with Jordan when she discovers that he has difficulty reading.

videos.title: Strangers in the House
videos.overview: Sharon's dad has a heart attack that causes Graham to question his own mortality and puts stress on his marriage while the event mends the broken friendship between Sharon and Angela.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Angela finds herself in 1963 during a mystical Halloween experience; Graham and Patty create some magic of their own with the help of medieval Halloween costumes.

videos.title: Other People's Mothers
videos.overview: Patty gains strides in her relationship with Angela when she helps Rayanne during an overdose.

videos.title: Life of Brian
videos.overview: Brian's life is a constant struggle over what he wants to express and the ramblings that escape from his mouth; everyone feels like the outsider at the ""World Happiness Dance"" at school; Patty pressures Graham into taking a continuing education cooking class.

videos.title: Self-Esteem
videos.overview: Self-esteem is the lesson of the day for Angela's warped relationship with Jordan, Brian's unreciprocated devotion to Angela, Rickie's flair for the dramatic, and Graham's cooking expertise.

videos.title: Pressure
videos.overview: Angela must make the decision whether or not to sleep with Jordan, while Graham is being pressured into going into the restaurant business with Hallie Lowenthal.

videos.title: On the Wagon
videos.overview: Rayanne has been sober for 33 days. To start getting her life back together again and to spend more time with Angela, she joins Jordan's band. But after a case of stage fright and a glimpse at what being sober really means, she goes back to the bottle.

videos.title: So-Called Angels
videos.overview: The Chase's Christmas is more complicated than usual when Angela's anxious search for Rickie leads her into the world of runaway kids where she encounters a mysterious homeless girl.

videos.title: Resolutions
videos.overview: It's New Year's Eve and while everyone else is busy making or breaking his or her resolutions, Rickie faces an increasingly difficult situation.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Angela realizes she is over Jordan and is in to someone else. But Brian Cracow catches Rayanne and Jordan on tape having sex.

videos.title: Weekend
videos.overview: On a romantic weekend getaway to ""reconnect"" with Graham, Patty reveals another side of her personality; Angela copes with a visit from Rayanne, who has good reason not to leave.

videos.title: In Dreams Begin Responsibilities
videos.overview: Jordan asks Brian for help on winning back Angela's affections; Sharon and Rayanne reach a turning point in their relationship; and Rickie learns that the new girl has a crush on him.

awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 6 wins & 12 nominations total
